description: v74 (2026-05-23) — Mohit + Parth feedback. Surfaces opening name + idea on early opening moves that R13 (central-pawn) doesn't cover — e.g. m2 d6 in Philidor, m2 Nf3 development. Falls between R13 (m1-m2 central pawns) and R_PROMOTED_opening (≥3 matched setup steps). Authored intros live in services/game_decryption_v5_service.py's get_opening_introduction map.
